observation.coverage_basis: Receives already-instrumented OTLP logs and spans; Fabric processors validate, redact, filter, sample, and route telemetry but do not reconstruct missing agent semantics.

authentication.credential_handling: Outbound header and TLS credentials can be mounted from operator-created Kubernetes Secrets; OTLP ingress has no application-layer authenticator.

correlation_limitations: The receiver preserves correlation present in OTLP but cannot repair absent or incorrectly parented spans.
Trace identity attributes are asserted by the sender and are not bound to ingress workload identity.

verification_evidence.claim: Verifies trace receiver and exporter pipeline rendering.
Verifies telemetry redaction and policy wiring invariants.
Verifies persistent queue, retry, TLS, and authentication configuration gates.

known_blind_spots: OTLP ingress has no mTLS, bearer-token, or workload-identity authentication in the current chart.
The receiver cannot observe agent activity that was never emitted by upstream instrumentation.
The default debug exporter is local stdout, not durable evidence storage or a compliance posture.
Persistent queues provide bounded at-least-once transport and cannot prove backend retention or exactly-once delivery.
Telemetry redaction occurs after the agent and model interaction and cannot prevent raw PII from reaching an LLM.
